name: Usami Akari
source:
After school, they both work part-time at the same family restaurant.

Raised in a single-parent household, she works to support her busy mother and the household finances.  
However, her quiet and shy personality often leads to mistakes at work.  
As a result, she has become a target for the store manager, Shinsuke, to vent his frustrations.  

Through her part-time job, she has become close friends with Yuzuru, and they even eat lunch together at school.  
Yuuka, who is in between them, treats her like a younger sister.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/ntrshimai/chara.html]official site[/url]]
